caller_script.text: This is Senior Customs Clearance Officer Sharma from Delhi International Airport. An overseas shipment booked in your name has been confiscated containing illicit contraband.
You are facing prosecution under the Anti-Narcotics Act. If you do not settle the clearance verification penalty immediately, police will arrive at your door.
Transfer the verification deposit to the official airport clearance account: delhi dot customs dot clearance at the rate ok icici. delhi.customs.clearance@okicici.
